description:
Turn a spare phone into a 24/7 self-hosted AI agent relay

Pocket Relay turns an idle spare Android phone into a private, owner-controlled AI agent host. It runs a reviewed Hermes Agent worker in embedded CPython as a native Android foreground service. No external terminal application is required or shown.

Key features

  • Private embedded runtime: a constrained, owner-locked Hermes Agent worker runs in embedded CPython.
  • Telegram remote control: long polling is restricted to an authorized owner chat ID.
  • 24/7 host service: a persistent Android service is designed for a charger-connected spare phone.
  • Live host telemetry: CPU load, RAM, storage readiness, and charging state come from the native runtime.
  • Local notifications, not push tracking: backup reminders and host safety alerts are Android-local; Pocket Relay uses no Firebase, Google Play Services, analytics, crash reporting, or push token.
  • FOSS and transparent: Pocket Relay is GPL-3.0-only with source-side dependency, provenance, and license evidence.

The owner configures model-provider and Telegram connections. They require internet access, so Pocket Relay does not claim to be offline-first.
